name: Blast Mine

description.content: After repairing [40%] of Generators, use <Active Ability> to trap a Generator for [120s]. All Survivors see the Auras of trapped Generators.
When the Killer damages a trapped Generator, it explodes, then:

items: Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.

quote: "You want S.T.A.R.S.? I'll give you S.T.A.R.S.!" -Jill Valentine
